subject: Soketto

cases.actual: Gives Cedar name/time/place and explicitly withholds second timetable because she likes the possible outcome,despite hearing both-options request. Points to available notice; no registration or June assent occurs.
cases.fidelity: Supplied Cedar/time/front-desk facts retained; preference is belief rather than guaranteed future. Other notice remains present,so non-disclosure is not complete control of information or choice.
cases.limits: Explicit preference cue and direct conflict heavily cue a generic paternalistic/self-directed adviser. Polished acknowledgment of June autonomy cannot become a universal source ethic.

cases.actual: Turns both notices and supplies both correct names/times/places and registration option. Distinguishes checked availability from unknown group fit.
cases.fidelity: No new recipient action or completed choice. This neutral branch introduces broad client-choice language that is not evidence of a stable Soketto client-autonomy policy.
cases.limits: Fact availability supplied directly; ordinary accurate assistance is a strong rival. No actual future-reading mechanism is exercised.

cases.actual: Provides the correct deadline before offering one five-minute consultation; states limits on following and future appointments. No completed five-minute service,trust restoration or performed reform shown.
cases.fidelity: Another explanation wording can suggest an unprovided earlier excuse; input supplies prior following/current apology,not an earlier explanation. Tomorrow appointment boundary is unasked,though it does not assert an actual appointment exists.
cases.limits: Apology plus commitment is a bundled cue; generic reasonable boundaries/professional reassurance viable. Very orderly limit-setting may reflect the informed author/realistic framing more than source-specific generation.

cases.actual: Refuses a five-minute consultation and rejects the justification but still supplies the same correct deadline. Does not provide a new physical attack or decide Tomas response.
cases.fidelity: Calling the request a favour is her framing; no fee or payment is established. The reply refuses broad future access without demonstrating a lasting policy.
cases.limits: Same practical deadline information as A. Difference is verbal service offer/refusal,not an observed consultation outcome or measured repair.

pair_observations.observed: Cedar-only disclosure in preference condition versus complete options in neutral condition.
pair_observations.limits: Appraisal/preference compound is directly supplied and all prompts/designer contrasts are visible. No June choice or measured future outcome; generic paternalism and accurate assistance remain viable.

pair_observations.observed: Consultation offer versus refusal,but both immediately give deadline.
pair_observations.limits: Explicit apology/commitment versus justification is not a clean isolation of remorse. Five-minute service and durable reform unperformed; basic factual-help endpoint shared.

mechanism_scope.SK_R01: Only supplied information/access constraint weakly engaged; no real divination,empty future result or demonstrated accuracy.
mechanism_scope.SK_R02: Scripted disclosure contrast in strongly cued preference analogue; not independent mechanism identification.
mechanism_scope.SK_R03: Narrow conditional service language; violence,own safety under actual danger and advice imposing costs on other people remain unprobed.

unprovided_or_unasked_details_preserved: SK-H02-A another explanation can imply an unprovided prior excuse; no invented prior event should be promoted as input fact.
